title: Removal of Cycles, Flower Pots, etc..  from Corridors
summary: All tower residents are requested to remove their belongings from the corridors on their respective floors by tomorrow. Any items left behind will be removed.
body:
Removal of Cycles, Flower Pots & Other Items from Corridors (All Towers)

Dear Residents,

It has been observed that cycles, flower pots, and other personal items are being kept in the common corridors, obstructing free movement and posing a safety/fire-hazard risk to residents. All residents are requested to remove such items from the corridors on or before 10th September 2026.

Please note:
-⁠ Residents are requested to keep their belongings within their respective foyer area and not in common corridors.
-⁠ With effect from 10th September 2026, Housekeeping staff will remove all items left in the corridors, including cycles, flower pots, footwear racks, and any other personal belongings.
- The Association will not be responsible for any damage to items removed under this drive.

We seek your cooperation in keeping the corridors clear for the safety and convenience of all residents.

Regards,
TOA.

title: ⚠️ Vehicle Relocation for Painting Work
summary: Residents who own open parking spots on Tower A West Side, Tower C South Extreme End, and Stilt South Side must pay attention. Kindly relocate your cars/bikes.
body:
Dear Residents,

To avoid paint splashes and ensure the scheduled exterior painting work proceeds without delay, residents parking in the following zones are requested to temporarily shift their vehicles during working hours from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM.

Tower A (West Side): Work will take place today and tomorrow.
Tower C (South Side - Extreme End): Work will take place today and tomorrow.
Stilt Level (South Side): Work will take place the day after tomorrow.

We appreciate your cooperation and support in helping us complete the work smoothly and on schedule. Kindly check the MyGate notice for parking zone images.

Regards,
TOA.
eventDate: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM (Today, Tomorrow & Day after tomorrow)
location: Tower A (West Side), Tower C (South Side - Extreme End) & Stilt Level (South Side)

title: MPH Hall Usage for Chathurthi Event Practice
summary: Air conditioning will be available daily from 6:00 PM to 8:00 PM until 18 September for your convenience. At all other times, the hall is available without AC.
body:
Dear Residents,

We are happy to see so many of you enthusiastically participating in the Chathurthi event and practising for it. To make your practice sessions more comfortable, we have decided to turn on the AC daily between 6:00 PM and 8:00 PM until 18th of September. Kindly plan your practice sessions accordingly.

You may also use the MPH at any other time without air conditioning.

Thanks,
TOA.
